title: 第13章 魔药师的逼格第14章 席梦娜
content_zh:
同班同学，同龄人，有亲戚关系，身份地位相仿，这几个条件加起来，除了辈分大一辈这点比较膈应人外，两人的关系确实亲近不少。
默里·格林一边与尼克·布朗交谈，一边吃着肉排，两块肉排下腹，默里·格林忽然发现，今天的饱腹感并不强烈，平常两块肉排能有八分饱，结果今天却只有七分饱。
‘胃口变大了？不会长胖吧！应该不会，十六岁，正是长身体的时候，胃口大点也很正常。’
想到这，默里·格林把餐盘里起装饰作用的蔬菜也塞进了嘴里，然后一口气将葡萄果汁喝完，做了个收尾。
‘不能挑食，得补充维生素。’
“额，默里你今晚有空没，我们一起去服务区看看，怎么样。”
看着做完光盘行动的默里·格林，尼克·布朗低头看了下自己餐盘中剩下的食物，不过他也没放在心上，满脸兴奋的邀请对方一起去学生服务区。
“没问题，听说服务区里面特别热闹，我早就想进去瞧瞧了。”
面对尼克·布朗的邀请，对于学生服务区同样挺感兴趣的默里·格林马上答应下来，一起朝着学生服务区走去。
整个埃利斯学院可以由三部分组成，三部分按“品”字分布，魔法分校、战士分校、学生服务区。
魔法分校和战士分校占据“品”下方双口，这两部分很简单，就是教学区，师生宿舍。
而这个学生服务区就比较复杂了，学生服务区里面可以说是一个为老师和学生服务的大购物、休闲区、饭店、制衣店、武器店、魔法药剂商店、酒吧......
所有你能想到的需求，基本上都能在这里得到满足，简直是一个缩小的城。
一路前行，两人发现不少魔法学院的学生也往服务区赶去，不过基本上都是才入学的新生。
想想也对，晚上正是魔法师冥想的最佳时间，也只有新生才有时间去逛服务区，加上魔法学院十分寂静，年少青春的学生怎么可能耐得住寂寞，一直待在魔法学院。
一走进学生服务区，入眼的便是一条购物街，街道两边皆是店铺，成群结队的学生在街道上购物游玩，还有不少学生在空地上摆着地摊，售卖物品。
“来瞧一瞧，看一看，才从卡亚斯山狩猎的二级魔兽疾风狼，看看它的狼牙，利爪，炼器必备，狼皮坚韧无比，缝制一下就是一件防具。”
“它的死亡时间不超过三个小时，肉质非常新鲜，吃了强身健体啊！”
一个穿着铠甲，战士打扮的高大学长正在吆喝，他旁边有个游侠打扮，腰间配着把单手剑，身上沾着不少鲜血的队友正在招呼客人。
他们面前摆着一具已经处理过的疾风狼尸体，这狼的尸体有水牛那个大，四周围着不少同学。

“同学，狼牙怎么卖？”
一个穿着皮甲，背着一柄长弓的同学仔细打量狼牙后，开始向摊主询价。
“獠牙一金币，尖牙五十银币。”
“好，一颗獠牙，两颗尖牙。”
长弓同学也没讨价还价，掏出两枚金币递给战士学长。
然后从小腿上抽出一把匕首，自己从狼嘴上撬下一颗獠牙，两颗尖牙，掏出块布包好后，小心翼翼的塞进怀中。
魔兽是经过魔法粒子洗礼，拥有魔力的强大生物，最弱的一级魔兽都比一般的战士学徒或魔法师学徒强大。
它们身上的每个部位都有独特的作用，牙齿是做箭头的极品材料，可以轻松洞穿魔兽坚韧的皮毛鳞甲。
content_en:
They are classmates, peers, relatives, and have similar status. Adding up these conditions, except for the fact that they are a generation older than each other, the relationship between the two is indeed very close.
While talking to Nick Brown, Murray Green was eating a steak. With two steaks under his belly, Murray Green suddenly realized that he didn't feel full today. Normally, two steaks would make him eighty percent full, but today he was only seventy percent full.
‘Has your appetite increased? You won’t gain weight! Probably not. Sixteen years old is the time when your body is growing, so it is normal to have a larger appetite. ’
Thinking of this, Murray Green stuffed the decorative vegetables on the plate into his mouth, and then drank the grape juice in one go to finish.
‘You can’t be picky about food, you have to take vitamin supplements. ’
"Uh, Murray, are you free tonight? How about we go to the service area and take a look."
Looking at Murray Green who had finished the CD operation, Nick Brown looked down at the food left on his plate, but he didn't take it to heart and invited him to the student service area with excitement on his face.
"No problem. I heard that the service area is very lively. I have wanted to go in and have a look."
Faced with Nick Brown's invitation, Murray Green, who was also very interested in the student service area, immediately agreed and walked towards the student service area together.
The entire Ellis Academy can be composed of three parts. The three parts are distributed according to the word "pin": the magic branch, the warrior branch, and the student service area.
The Magic Branch and the Warrior Branch occupy the two openings under the "Pin". These two parts are very simple, they are the teaching area and the dormitories for teachers and students.
The student service area is more complicated. It can be said that it is a large shopping, leisure area, restaurant, clothing store, weapons store, magic potion store, bar that serves teachers and students...
All the needs you can think of can basically be met here. It is simply a shrunk city.
Along the way, the two found that many students from the Magic Academy were also rushing to the service area, but they were basically freshmen who had just entered the school.
It's right to think about it. Night is the best time for magicians to meditate. Only freshmen have time to visit the service area. In addition, the magic academy is very quiet. How can young students endure loneliness and stay in the magic academy all the time.
As soon as you walk into the student service area, you will see a shopping street. There are shops on both sides of the street. Groups of students are shopping and playing on the street. There are also many students setting up stalls in the open space to sell items.
"Come and take a look, take a look at the second-level magical beast Wind Wolf that was just hunted from Kayas Mountain. Look at its fangs and claws, which are essential for weapon refining. The wolf skin is extremely tough and can be sewn into a piece of armor."
"Its death time is no more than three hours, and the meat is very fresh. You can strengthen your health by eating it!"
A tall college president wearing armor and warrior attire was shouting. Next to him, a teammate dressed as a ranger with a one-handed sword on his waist and a lot of blood on his body was greeting the guests.
In front of them was a carcass of a blast wolf that had been processed. The carcass of the wolf was as big as a buffalo, surrounded by many classmates.
"Classmate, how do you sell wolf teeth?"
A classmate wearing leather armor and carrying a long bow carefully looked at the wolf fang and began to inquire about the price from the stall owner.
"One gold coin for the tusk, fifty silver coins for the fang."
"Okay, one fang, two fangs."
Classmate Long Gong didn't bargain and took out two gold coins and handed them to Senior Warrior.
Then he pulled out a dagger from his calf, pried off a fang and two canines from the wolf's mouth, took out a piece of cloth, wrapped it, and carefully stuffed it into his arms.
Warcraft are powerful creatures that have been baptized by magic particles and possess magical power. The weakest first-level Warcraft is more powerful than the average warrior apprentice or magician apprentice.
Every part of their body has a unique function, and their teeth are used to make arrows.The best material can easily penetrate the tough fur and scales of monsters.
